_meta.spec_name: The State of Play — Design System
_meta.note: This file mirrors the shipped code. Prior versions referenced Playfair Display / IBM Plex Sans + blue/orange accents — those are archived; the live system below is what actually ships.

display.role: H1/H2 on masthead + reading pages, marketing headlines

reading.role: Article body copy (editorial-prose-quiet), long-form pull quotes

body.role: UI copy, byline, share row, labels, buttons

burgundy.role: Primary CTA, active nav, section rules, subscribe buttons, gift modal, paywall

colour.usage_rule: Always prefer CSS variables (var(--text), var(--text-muted), var(--text-label), var(--rule), var(--bg)) over hardcoded hex, so dark/light mode swaps correctly. Only exception: brand ink #234ba0 in the logo asset.

layout.borders: hairline rules (1px, var(--rule)) — no shadows, no rounded corners

components.cta_button: Rectangular, no radius, uppercase 13px letter-spacing 0.05em, bg burgundy
components.font_size_toggle: Leftmost of utility strip, label 'Text size' 12px uppercase, S | M | L switch
components.share_row: Right of utility strip, 12px uppercase, hover to text primary; Gift icon (lucide) last for subscribers only
components.paywall: 180px gradient fade eating last preview paragraph, then burgundy Lock badge + editorial heading + Razorpay CTA

dark_mode_logo: TODO — currently uses CSS invert on the single /tsop-logo.png. Muddy on the wordmark. Replace with a proper light-on-transparent variant when time permits.
